vocabulary.notes: Vietnamese vocabulary: tonal distinction awareness, classifier usage, Sino-Vietnamese loanwords, regional dialect variations

grammar.notes: Vietnamese grammar: topic-comment structure, aspect markers (đã, đang, sẽ), classifier system, pronoun hierarchy based on age/status

reading.notes: Vietnamese reading comprehension: diacritic sensitivity, understanding implicit meaning in indirect communication style

writing.notes: Vietnamese writing: correct use of tone marks, proper word spacing, formal/informal register shifts, coherent argumentation

listening.notes: Vietnamese listening: tone perception in connected speech, understanding rapid colloquial reductions, regional accent variations

speaking.notes: Vietnamese speaking: accurate tone production, appropriate pronoun selection based on social context, use of discourse particles (và, nhưng, mà)
